title: Who Is A God Like You

request.style: English, female solo voice with warm choir, Celtic harp, bodhran, fiddle, uilleann pipes, mournful and hopeful, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
What misery is mine alone
Gathering summer fruit in vain
Like gleaning when the grapes are gone
No early figs remain

The faithful have vanished away
Not one upright person stands
They lie in wait for blood each day
Hunting brothers with their hands

[Chorus]
Who is a God like you
Pardons guilt and passes by
You do not hold your anger true
You delight in mercy

[Verse]
Best of them is like a briar
Most upright a thorned hedge
Day of your reckoning is here
Confusion on their ledge

Put no trust in a neighbor
Rely on no friend
Guard your words from every power
From the wife in your end

[Chorus]
Who is a God like you
Pardons guilt and passes by
You do not hold your anger true
You delight in mercy

[Bridge]
Son treats father with contempt
Daughter rises against
Enemies are the household tent
Broken bonds are at last

But as for me I will look
To the Lord I will wait
My God will hear my voice
In this darkened state

[Outro]
Hurl our sins to the sea
Show faithfulness to Jacob
Mercy to Abraham see
As you swore in days past
